description: Feature work across a TypeScript monorepo: React front end, Nest.js API and a PostgreSQL schema shared by both, with an LLM-backed summarisation feature added in 2025.
responsibilities: Owned features end to end, from the API contract through the React interface to the deployment that shipped them
Maintained the shared PostgreSQL schema and the migrations that changed it, coordinating breaking changes across two services
Reviewed the team's pull requests and kept the monorepo's testing conventions consistent as it grew
achievements: Cut the median API response time on the busiest endpoint by rewriting an N+1 query as a single join
Added a summarisation feature backed by the OpenAI API, including the retry and fallback handling for when it is unavailable

description: Product engineering on a subscription analytics tool: React dashboards over a Node and GraphQL API, with reporting queries against PostgreSQL.
responsibilities: Built the reporting dashboards and the GraphQL resolvers behind them
Introduced Redis caching for report queries that had been recomputed on every page load
Wrote the integration tests that ran against a real database rather than mocks
achievements: Took the reporting page from a timeout under large accounts to a consistent sub-second load by caching and paginating it

description: Frontend work on client websites, building interfaces from designs and the small APIs behind them.
responsibilities: Implemented responsive interfaces from design files and wired them to the APIs serving them
Fixed accessibility issues reported by client audits, mostly keyboard navigation and contrast
